transcript.text: We had a power cut last night and now our Candy washer dryer is completely dead - no lights, nothing. Everything else in the house came back on. The plug fuse is fine, I swapped it. Help!

I can't diagnose that problem with your washer dryer here yet, so I won't guess at a cause or a part. If there's any burning smell, sparking, smoke or water near the electrics, stop using it and switch it off at the wall. Otherwise an appliance engineer can look at it, or tell me about a different problem with it.
